AttributeHint.Strength: Raw physical power. It measures how hard you hit, how much you can lift and carry, and how well you can push, pull, or break things.
AttributeHint.Agility: Speed and reflexes. It measures how quickly you move, react, and dodge danger.
AttributeHint.Dexterity: Precision and fine motor control. It measures your aim and how skillfully you handle weapons, tools, and delicate tasks.
AttributeHint.Intellect: Reasoning, memory, and knowledge. It measures how well you learn, analyze, and solve problems.
AttributeHint.Spirit: Willpower and inner strength. It measures your resolve, your connection to mystical forces, and your resistance to fear and mental influence.
AttributeHint.Charisma: Force of personality. It measures how well you persuade, lead, inspire, and deceive others.

SkillHint.Acrobatics: Keeping your balance, tumbling, flipping, and landing safely from falls.
SkillHint.Coordination: Performing tasks that demand precise, synchronized movements, such as juggling, catching, or doing two things at once.
SkillHint.Deception: Lying convincingly, disguising your intentions, and misleading others.
SkillHint.Gymnastics: Climbing, jumping, swimming, and other feats of physical exertion.
SkillHint.Insight: Reading people, sensing their true intentions, and noticing when someone is lying.
SkillHint.Intimidation: Influencing others through threats, fear, or a show of force.
SkillHint.Investigation: Searching for clues, analyzing evidence, and drawing conclusions.
SkillHint.Lore: Knowledge of history, legends, ancient cultures, and the world's past.
SkillHint.Medicine: Treating wounds, diagnosing illnesses, and stabilizing the injured.
SkillHint.Mysticism: Knowledge of magic, the arcane, the divine, and supernatural phenomena.
SkillHint.Perception: Noticing your surroundings, spotting hidden things, and hearing faint sounds.
SkillHint.Persuasion: Convincing others through reason, diplomacy, and charm.
SkillHint.Society: Knowledge of politics, laws, customs, and social structures.
SkillHint.Stealth: Moving silently, hiding, and staying unnoticed.
SkillHint.Survival: Tracking, foraging, navigating, and enduring the wilderness.
SkillHint.Thievery: Picking locks, disarming traps, and picking pockets.

Downtime.Title: Downtime

Downtime.RecoverHint: 24 hours of rest in good conditions. Recover all of your Life and Resources, and remove 1 Wound.

ConditionHint.blinded: You can't see. You automatically fail all Tests that require sight, you make attacks with Disadvantage, and attacks against you have Advantage.
ConditionHint.deafened: You can't hear. You automatically fail all Tests that require hearing.
ConditionHint.mute: You can't speak, and you can't Conjure Spells.
ConditionHint.burned: You are on fire. At the end of your Turn, if you still have this Condition, you take Medium Heat damage based on the Condition's Tier. To end the Condition early, you must become Prone and roll on the ground. Water, ice, and the Chilled condition also end Burned.
ConditionHint.chilled: You are freezing. At the end of your Turn, you take Weak Freeze damage based on the Condition's Tier, and your Speed is halved. Warming yourself up or gaining the Burned condition ends Chilled.
ConditionHint.deprived:
Represents the physical deterioration of your body caused by poor nourishment and other hardships. It has 5 Levels:
1. Disadvantage on attacks and Conjuring.
2. Your Speed is halved.
3. Disadvantage on all Attribute Tests.
4. Your maximum Life is halved.
5. Every time you gain another Level of this Condition, you gain 1 Wound.
ConditionHint.fainted: You have lost consciousness, becoming Incapacitated and Prone. You drop everything you're holding, your Speed becomes 0, and you're unaware of your surroundings. Attacks from within 1 Zone automatically hit and are Critical Hits, and you automatically fail Strength, Agility, and Dexterity Tests.
ConditionHint.hidden: You are hidden from a creature. Your attacks against that creature have Advantage, and its attacks against you have Disadvantage. Making noise, being seen, attacking, and other Actions can make you lose this Condition.
ConditionHint.injured: You are Injured while you have half or less of your maximum Life.
ConditionHint.scared: You are afraid of something. You can't willingly move toward the source of your fear, and you roll with Disadvantage while the source of your fear is within your sight.
ConditionHint.incapacitated: You can only take Movement Actions, you are Mute, and you can't take Reactions. You lose Concentration.
ConditionHint.prone: You are lying on the ground and can only move by Crawling. Your attacks have Disadvantage. Attacks against you from within 1 Zone have Advantage, while Ranged Attacks from farther away have Disadvantage. You can use Stand Up to end this Condition.
ConditionHint.restrained: Your Speed becomes 0. Attacks against you have Advantage, and your attacks have Disadvantage.
ConditionHint.concentrating:
You are concentrating on a Spell. Its duration depends on the Spell, and it can end in the following ways:
 - You end it voluntarily.
 - You Conjure another Concentration Spell.
 - You take damage. To maintain Concentration, make a Test with your Conjuring Attribute against a Difficulty of 10 or half the damage you took, whichever is higher.
 - You become Incapacitated or die.
ConditionHint.stunned: You are stunned. You are Incapacitated, you automatically fail Strength, Agility, and Dexterity Tests, and attacks against you have Advantage.
ConditionHint.dodging: Attacks against you have Disadvantage until your next Turn.
ConditionHint.squeezing: Moving through a space one Size smaller than you: you are Prone and can only Crawl, you have Disadvantage on attacks and on Strength and Agility Tests, melee attacks against you have Advantage and ranged attacks have Disadvantage.
ConditionHint.cover: +2 Defense against attacks. Ranged attacks with Eagle Eye ignore it.
ConditionHint.totalCover: You can't be hit by attacks.

ActionHint.move: Move a number of Zones up to your Speed.
ActionHint.dropProne: You willingly gain the Prone condition.
ActionHint.crawl: While Prone, you can only move by Crawling. Movement costs +1 Zone, or +2 Zones through Difficult Terrain.
ActionHint.standUp: Remove the Prone condition. Standing up costs 2 Zones of movement.
ActionHint.climb: Climbing costs +1 Zone, or +2 Zones through Difficult Terrain, unless you have a Climb Speed.
ActionHint.swim: Swimming costs +1 Zone, or +2 Zones through Difficult Terrain, unless you have a Swim Speed.
ActionHint.attack: You make an attack with a Weapon, an Unarmed Attack, or another attack source.
ActionHint.dash: You gain additional movement equal to your Speed.
ActionHint.interact: You interact with a second object. Interacting with one object is free.
ActionHint.search: You search for something using your Attributes or Skills.
ActionHint.hide: You make a Test to hide. On a success, you gain the Hidden condition.
ActionHint.disengage: You make a careful retreat, preventing Opportunity Attacks.
ActionHint.dodge: Attacks against you have Disadvantage until your next Turn.
ActionHint.improvise: If the Action you want to perform doesn't fit any of the others, you can improvise. The Game Master determines the Test, the Difficulty, and whether the Action is possible.
ActionHint.secondaryAttack: You make an attack with your Secondary Weapon.
ActionHint.opportunityAttack: If a creature leaves your Melee Reach without using Disengage, you can make an attack against it. Forced Movement doesn't trigger this attack.

DamageTypeHint.blunt: Damage caused by impact, crushing force, or heavy pressure, such as hammers, falls, or powerful strikes.
DamageTypeHint.cut: Damage caused by edges that slice or tear through a target, such as swords, axes, or claws.
DamageTypeHint.thrust: Damage caused by a concentrated point piercing a target, such as spears, arrows, or other pointed Weapons.
DamageTypeHint.blast: Damage caused by explosive force, shockwaves, intense sound, or sudden pressure.
DamageTypeHint.heat: Damage caused by fire, extreme temperatures, or other sources of intense heat.
DamageTypeHint.freeze: Damage caused by extreme cold, ice, or effects that rapidly drain heat from the target.
DamageTypeHint.arcane: Damage caused directly by raw magical energy and supernatural forces.
DamageTypeHint.lightning: Damage caused by electricity, lightning, or powerful electrical discharges.

WeaponPropertyHint.light: You can equip two Light Weapons and use the second one for your Secondary Attack.
WeaponPropertyHint.twoHanded: Requires two hands to use. Attacks made with one hand deal half damage.
WeaponPropertyHint.versatile: If you attack with two hands, the Weapon's damage goes up one category.

WeaponPropertyHint.range: Attacks within X Zones are made normally. Attacks beyond X and up to Y Zones have Disadvantage. You can't hit targets beyond Y Zones.
WeaponPropertyHint.heavy: Requires 2 Strength to use. Otherwise, your attacks with it have Disadvantage.

ArmorPropertyHint.restrictive: You have Disadvantage on Agility and Dexterity Tests.
ArmorPropertyHint.heavy: Requires 2 Strength to use. Otherwise, your Speed is halved.
ArmorPropertyHint.covering: You can use your Main Action to plant the shield in the ground, gaining Partial Cover in one direction until you pick it up.
ArmorPropertyHint.reinforced: You have Resistance to the listed damage type.
ArmorPropertyHint.vulnerable: You have Weakness to the listed damage type.
ArmorPropertyHint.warded: You are immune to the listed Condition.
ArmorPropertyHint.focused: You have Advantage on Tests to maintain Concentration.
ArmorPropertyHint.deflecting: When a Ranged Attack hits you, you can use your Reaction to make the attacker reroll it with Disadvantage.
ArmorPropertyHint.bashing: The shield can be used as a Weapon that deals Medium Blunt damage and uses Strength.

ClassSummary.Archer: Fights from a distance with bows and crossbows, keeping a blade for when enemies get too close.
ClassSummary.Healer: Caster who keeps the group standing: heals wounds, brings back the fallen and supports allies.
ClassSummary.Mage: Hurls raw mana for huge damage, at a cost to their own body. Can't Conjure Concentration Spells.
ClassSummary.Thief: Fast and dirty fighter: every hit builds Combo, spent on Finishers to hit harder or vanish.
ClassSummary.Warrior: Disciplined fighter who masters combat Techniques and builds their own fighting style.
